verdict.rationale: Greenhouse has an onboarding product with consistent milestones and 30-day goals (greenhouse-docs-28). It also fires a 'Candidate hired' webhook (greenhouse-docs-17), which could push new-hire data to downstream systems, but that requires building a custom integration. Nothing in the pack documents native HRIS or payroll connectors, or an automatic handoff from a signed offer to onboarding without re-entry. Missing for 10: documented HRIS/payroll integrations, an evidenced offer-to-onboarding data handoff, field mapping that avoids re-entry, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
